submitted.rationale: XRD showed that all five films share the Pt substrate peaks (Q ≈ 2.78, 3.21, 4.54, 5.32 give an fcc pattern with a ≈ 3.91 Å). A peak at Q ≈ 1.94 (d ≈ 3.24 Å) shows up at V ≥ ~0.4 and matches a (Cr,Fe)VO4-type vanadate. I put the merit budget into that vanadate region. Photocurrent rose as Cr replaced Fe at V ≈ 0.5: 47 (Cr 0.10) gave 2e-8 A, 91 (Cr 0.26) gave 9e-8 A and 59 (Cr 0.375) gave 2e-7 A. Index 59 is the best of the three I measured.

rejected.reason: Measured 2e-8 A. Fe-rich vanadate with low Cr.
Measured 9e-8 A. Lower than 59, which has more Cr.
XRD showed only substrate peaks and no vanadate phase. Given the small merit budget, I measured the vanadate region instead.
